operational.description: Job credential. Grants access to operational core tools and ACTIVE dynamic extensions.

maintainer.description: Maintenance credential. Grants access to all operational tools PLUS maintainer-plane lifecycle tools and registry queries.

notes: Both headers are checked; X-Maintenance-Token takes precedence if both present.
Credentials are compared with constant-time comparison.
No credential is ever returned in any response body, error envelope, or log.

GET /v1/tools.description: List available tools (filtered by caller's privilege plane)

visibility_semantics.operational_core: Always visible to operational and maintainer planes.
visibility_semantics.maintainer_core: Visible only to maintainer plane. Hidden from operational callers.
visibility_semantics.active_extensions: Visible only to maintainer plane. Hidden from operational callers.
visibility_semantics.non_active_revisions: DRAFT, VALIDATED, TESTED, DISABLED revisions are NEVER visible. Only ACTIVE revisions appear as callable tools.

POST /v1/<tool_name>.request_body: JSON object matching the tool's input schema

dynamic_extensions.description: Tools created via the extension lifecycle. Only ACTIVE revisions are callable.

transitions.upsert: Creates or returns a revision (DRAFT if new, existing if source unchanged)
transitions.disable: ACTIVE -> DISABLED (removed from registry, revision preserved)
transitions.rollback: ACTIVE -> previous known-good revision becomes ACTIVE

extension_lifecycle.visibility: Only ACTIVE revisions appear in GET /v1/tools. DRAFT/VALIDATED/TESTED/DISABLED are never callable.

UNAUTHORIZED.description: Missing or invalid credentials, or insufficient privilege for the requested tool

NOT_FOUND.description: Unknown tool name or no route for the request

BAD_REQUEST.description: Malformed JSON body, missing required parameters, or parameter type mismatch

security.credential_handling: Credentials are never returned in responses, error envelopes, or logs. The Gateway uses constant-time comparison.
security.audit: All tool invocations are audited with tool name, plane, params (redacted), status, duration, and client identifier.
security.rate_limiting: Not implemented at Gateway level. Caddy layer should apply rate limiting if needed.
security.tls: HTTPS only. Gateway binds 127.0.0.1:8787; Caddy is the sole public ingress.
